clips.title: The story
paras: At Ratchet's pier, a crate of alchemy supplies waits for passage across the sea. Wharfmaster Dizzywig arranges its journey to the Old World aboard a ship bound for Blackwater Cove.

A crate of potions and reagents waits at the Barrens port, bound for colleagues in the Old World. Caravans that might have carried it have already departed, so you are asked to take the secure shipment to Ratchet's water's edge. The port offers a route across the Great Sea between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

Wharfmaster Dizzywig handles cargo on Ratchet's wooden piers. He tracks shipments in ledgers and manifests, then finds space aboard vessels sailing east across the Great Sea. This crate is booked for a ship bound for Blackwater Cove.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have need to send a crate of potions, reagents and other items to my associates in the Old World. Little time I have to actually see them to the dock at Ratchet, and the last caravan has already left.
If you could, please take this to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. He will ensure that it is placed on the next boat to Blackwater Cove.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.
All taken care of! Good day to you, adventurer.
